text: Question: Why doesn't VoLTE/HD Voice work on my phone? Answer: ### Short Answer VoLTE requires a VoLTE-enabled handset, a compatible SIM, and the VoLTE/4G Calling setting enabled in device settings. Some imported or older devices may not support VoLTE on Indian bands even if they support 4G data. ### Detailed Explanation Three separate conditions need to align for VoLTE to work — the handset itself must be VoLTE-capable, the SIM must be compatible, and the setting must be turned on in the device — and the answer flags that some imported or older phones can do 4G data fine but still lack VoLTE support specifically on the bands used in India, which is a device limitation rather than an account or SIM issue. ### Key Details | Detail | Value | |---|---| | Requirements | VoLTE-enabled handset; compatible SIM; VoLTE/4G Calling setting enabled in device settings | | Known limitation | Some imported/older devices support 4G data but not VoLTE on Indian bands | ### Conditions - A device supporting 4G data does not guarantee VoLTE support — the two are independent capabilities. ### Troubleshooting | Symptom | Possible Cause | Diagnostic Check | Recommended Action | |---|---|---|---| | VoLTE toggle not visible in device settings | Handset isn't VoLTE-capable, or SIM isn't VoLTE-compatible | Whether the device is an imported/older model | Confirm device VoLTE support before assuming it's a settings issue | | VoLTE toggle present but calls still fall back to voice-only | Setting not actually enabled,
title: Why doesn't VoLTE/HD Voice work on my phone?
